result.reason: The redline appropriately gives the Software a 12-month documentation-conformity warranty from acceptance and retains correction, replacement, and refund remedies. However, it does not add the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty or compliance-with-laws warranty, and the malicious-code warranty remains limited to willfully introduced code. It also applies the 12-month period, measured from acceptance of the Software, to the MarketSite.net Service, exceeding the preferred 90-day services period and creating an unclear trigger for that service. The edits otherwise preserve the existing commercial framework, but the drafting retains grammatical and remedy ambiguities.
